scope: Already inspected archive. Fixed thresholds and lanes. No forward data, tuning, or promotion.
window_policy: Same UTC scoring bounds across all frames after M5 warmup and through the M30 cutoff. Earlier feed bars seed the detector and book. Count only campaigns with entry and final exit inside each slice. Count only complete directional-hour labels inside each slice.
cost_policy: Reuse registered GOLD PRO position size, next-open fill, fixed brackets, quote costs and conservative stop-first OHLC collision handling. Each additional cost layer adds 0.30 USD per unit spread, 0.10 USD per unit per side and 50% of recorded commission. Freeze admissions and fills across accounting stresses.
occupancy_policy: Recalculate the single slot and enforce original risk/capital checks. Original S5 gets same-bar priority and GOLD PRO plan names sort before WICK plans. Opposing non-S5 submissions on the same close are rejected. The native S5 tape only contains originally admitted offers. Archive overlays are fixed-offer counterfactuals.

lanes.BREAKOUT_A: All risk-valid WICK_BREAKOUT offers. Volume has no admission role.
lanes.BREAKOUT_B: Breakout A plus finite positive current volume and estimated favorable close-location share at least 0.65.
lanes.BREAKOUT_C: Breakout A plus current volume at least 1.25 times the mean of the preceding 20 positive finite bars.
lanes.BREAKOUT_HTF: Breakout A plus agreement of confirmed H1 and H4 with the formation side.
lanes.RETEST_A: Only independent WICK_RETEST offers after a confirmed break. Volume has no admission role.
lanes.BREAKOUT_A_RECLAIM_EXIT: Breakout A with early invalidation only after the same formation closes back inside its broken edge. Close any remaining units at the next open, preserving exit parts already settled. Keep original next-open stop handling and prior closes.
lanes.GOLD_FAST_WICK_FILTER: Require two same-side rejection wicks in the detector's completed formation window at GOLD FAST BREAKOUT submission. Other models retain original eligibility.
lanes.GOLD_CONFIRMED_WICK_FILTER: Same fixed filter applied separately to GOLD CONFIRMED BREAKOUT offers.
lanes.S5_PLUS_BREAKOUT_A: Overlay Breakout A on immutable native S5 offers and recalculate occupancy.
lanes.GOLD_FAST_PLUS_BREAKOUT_A: Overlay Breakout A on original GOLD FAST offers and recalculate occupancy.

observational: Count bullish and bearish watches, proximity to known support/resistance, close-confirmed breaks, provisional penetrations, failed formations, expired observations, and formation-to-plan latency. Compare watch, confirmation, offer, and fill timing against the original independent directional-hour labels. Outside-event observations are not by themselves losses.

primary_inference.metric: Paired stressed net R sum on later M5 archive. Use contiguous five-calendar-day blocks including flat days.
primary_inference.multiple_testing: Holm across every registered contrast. Descriptive because the archive was previously examined.
